independence: Wingless-only. No Yggdrasil evidence, manifests, thresholds, representations, outcomes, or successor decisions may be consumed.
hypothesis: The frozen R43 learning state contains enough ordinal decision information to choose the better of two competing fixed-total-budget interventions on genuinely unseen manifests even though its absolute-value calibration is inadequate.
competing_explanation: Any apparent ranking ability is explained by intervention identity/prior performance alone rather than target-manifest learning state.
historical_fit_partition: Existing R43 historical manifests only; no new-manifest outcomes or labels may enter state construction, offsets, pair selection, controls, or thresholds.
candidate_actions: Exact existing R27 ten-allocation fixed-total candidate set; evaluate all 36 unordered pairs among the nine non-equal allocations. Pair order canonicalized lexicographically before outcomes.
treatment: For each unseen manifest and action pair A,B, choose the action with larger frozen R43 state-conditional predicted value. Evaluation uses only pairwise winner correctness and regret; no magnitude calibration is performed or tuned.

controls.action_only: Rank A versus B by historical R43-partition mean realized value for each allocation, computed before unseen outcomes.
controls.state_shuffled: Deterministic preregistered permutation of historical manifest-state bindings before recomputing the same R43 scoring machinery; diagnostic only.

classification_rules.supported: valid; >=72 non-tie cases; aggregate R43 pairwise accuracy >=0.65; R43 exceeds action-only by >=0.10; R43 exceeds action-only on all three unseen manifests; and R43 mean decision regret is lower than action-only.
classification_rules.mixed: valid; support false; R43 exceeds action-only by >=0.05 and has lower mean decision regret, but misses absolute-accuracy or all-manifest consistency requirement.
classification_rules.negative: valid and neither supported nor mixed.
classification_rules.invalid: any frozen source/blob/prefix, candidate set, fixed budget, R43 identity, pair set/order, heldout ordering, capacity, deterministic replay, provenance, or accounting rule fails.

negative_interpretation: Stop further calibration/ranking tweaks over the current R43 representation. Escalate to a richer causal/latent learning-state representation under the same fixed resource envelope.
infra_failure_policy: Exact infrastructure repair and deterministic rerun only. Scientific negative/mixed outcomes are immutable evidence.
